days.title: A Promise After the Fall
days.lead: Humanity falls, but God does not end the story. He announces rescue at once.

days.title: The Ark and the Rainbow
days.lead: When everything falls apart, God prepares a way of rescue. After the disaster, He gives a sign that there is still a future.

days.title: Go to the Land I Will Show You
days.lead: Sometimes hope begins with a step into the unknown.

days.title: That’s Impossible!
days.lead: God’s promises are not limited by human possibilities.

days.title: Hagar in the Wilderness
days.lead: God sees the person everyone else has abandoned.

days.title: Isaac on Mount Moriah
days.lead: When no way out is in sight, God is already preparing one, long before we are able to see it.

days.title: Bethel and the Jabbok
days.lead: A man running from the consequences of his own mistakes can meet the God who transforms people who have fought all their lives.

days.title: From Betrayal to Forgiveness
days.lead: The evil others plan against us, God can turn to good. A family’s past does not have to decide its future.

days.title: A Bush in the Desert
days.lead: God can call a person who insists they are not fit for the job.

days.title: The Night of Freedom
days.lead: God can lead people out into freedom after years of slavery.

days.title: Crossing the Red Sea
days.lead: When there is no way out of a hard place, God can make one.

days.title: Manna and Water from the Rock
days.lead: God cares for His people on the long road, too. Even in the desert He provides springs.

days.title: The Spies’ Report
days.lead: Two people of faith can see the future differently than ten voices of fear.

days.title: The Golden Calf and the Bronze Serpent
days.lead: A great fall doesn’t have to mean the end of a relationship with God. The Lord shows a way of rescue, even when we have to bear the consequences of our own mistakes.

days.title: Rahab in Jericho
days.lead: Neither your past nor your background shuts you out of God’s future.

days.title: Gideon, the Least in His Family
days.lead: God sees potential where we see only our own weakness.

days.title: Ruth: From Loss to a New Beginning
days.lead: God can write a new chapter even when we have lost our home, our security and our future.

days.title: A Prayer from the Depths of the Heart
days.lead: God hears the prayers we pray through tears.

days.title: David Found Strength in the Lord
days.lead: In a moment of total collapse, strength can still be found in God.

days.title: David After Bathsheba
days.lead: Even a grave sin does not have to be the last word in a person’s story.

days.title: Elijah, a Handful of Flour, and a Still, Small Voice
days.lead: God multiplies the little that is left, and He does not reject a person who is exhausted, afraid, and ready to give up.

days.title: Naaman: The Healing of an Outsider
days.lead: God’s grace is not limited by nationality, religion, or social standing.

days.title: Jonah and Nineveh
days.lead: God gives a second chance both to a disobedient prophet and to a city that did not deserve one.

days.title: Samaria Under Siege and Hezekiah in Jerusalem
days.lead: A situation that seems hopeless can change in a single day, and no enemy is greater than God.

days.title: The Fire and the Lions
days.lead: God does not always remove the fire, but He is in it with us. Faithfulness makes sense even when it seems to lead to disaster.

days.title: Esther: For Such a Time as This
days.lead: God can put a person in exactly the right place to bring rescue to others.

days.title: Home from Babylon: Rebuilding Jerusalem
days.lead: Even seventy years of captivity do not mean that God has forgotten His people. What has lain in ruins for years can be rebuilt.

days.title: The Birth of Jesus
days.lead: God enters the darkness of the world not from a distance, but by becoming one of us.

days.title: They Lived to See the Promise
days.lead: Those who waited their whole lives saw the day come. God does not forget a person who prays for the same thing for years.

days.title: A Night of Empty Nets
days.lead: Jesus can step into an experience of failure and turn it into a calling.

days.title: The Woman at the Well
days.lead: Jesus starts a conversation with someone everyone else avoids, and she is the first to tell the whole town about Him.

days.title: Through the Roof
days.lead: The faith of friends opens a way where the sick man could never get on his own.

days.title: Calming the Storm
days.lead: Jesus’ presence brings hope even when it seems the boat is going down.

days.title: Feeding the Five Thousand
days.lead: What we have too little of can be enough once we give it to Jesus.

days.title: Lazarus, Come Out!
days.lead: Not even the grave is the limit of what God can do.

days.title: The Crucifixion and Resurrection of Jesus
days.lead: The greatest defeat turns out to be the greatest victory. Death does not get the last word.

days.title: The Road to Emmaus
days.lead: Jesus can walk beside a person who has lost hope long before that person recognizes Him.

days.title: Pentecost: The Birth of the Church
days.lead: God does not leave His disciples alone. He gives the Spirit, who turns fear into courage and makes a handful of people into a community that carries hope.

days.title: Saul Becomes Paul
days.lead: The greatest opponent can become one of God’s most important instruments.

days.title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
days.lead: History does not end in suffering, death, or decay. God makes all things new.
